title: Nonzero-Sum Stochastic Differential Games for Controlled Convection-Diffusion SPDEs
summary: This paper studies a two-player nonzero-sum stochastic differential game governed by a controlled convection-diffusion stochastic partial differential equation (SPDE) with spatially heterogeneous coefficients. The diffusion and transport operators depend on the players' controls, allowing each agent to influence the system dynamics. We prove the existence and uniqueness of solutions to both the forward uncontrolled SPDE and the associated adjoint backward SPDE (BSPDE) in a Hilbert space framework.
